messages:
sylvia: FYI customer asked for per-tenant outbound allowlists + operator SNAT pool for Private installs. They want policies to survive upgrades.
laura: Compliance-first. Do they expect agent enforcement or installer ACLs?
tim_r: Agent enforcement so rules are part of tenant manifests.
derek: Need RBAC: tenant-admin vs platform-admin edits, and a migration story.
jen: If we change egress backend (iptables -> eBPF -> cloud NAT) we must avoid breaking long-lived sessions.
laura: Proposal: declarative EgressPolicy CRD with enforcementVersion, agent compatibility shim, and documented migration windows.
tim_r: CRD sketch: allowedDestinations (fqdn/cidr), egressMode, snatPool, enforcementVersion.
derek: Add dnsResolutionPolicy and cache invalidation for FQDN rules.
sylvia: Acceptance criteria: CRD v1 + docs, iptables enforcer + optional eBPF, migration tests, console view, RBAC + audit logs.
ops-bot: created INFR-5123 egress-policy backlog: https://redwood.internal/board/INFR-5123
jen: Action items: laura+tim draft CRD by Thu EOD; derek+ops prototype shim; jen mock console wireframe.
laura: ack. :thumbsup:
